jobs.title: ICT Security SOC Analyst Job Co-operative Bank
jobs.description: IT Jobs, Co-operative Bank Jobs. ICT Security SOC Analyst monitors systems and coordinates incident responses, requiring an IT Bachelor’s, 1+ years security admin experience, and mandatory CEH/CySA+ certification. Full-time role in Nairobi.
responsibilities: Monitor the Bank’s networks and systems on a 24-hour basis using Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) tools to detect, analyse and investigate potential security threats.

Conduct proactive threat research, monitor open-source intelligence sources and identify emerging cyber threats that could affect the Bank. Recommend, implement and support appropriate defensive measures.
Triage security alerts, investigate suspicious activities, analyse security logs and support the containment, eradication and resolution of cyber incidents in collaboration with relevant ICT teams.
Analyse network and host-based security logs, including firewall, intrusion detection and system logs, to determine the appropriate corrective actions, mitigation measures and escalation pathways.
Maintain accurate records of security investigations, document incident response activities, track resolution actions and provide timely status updates and periodic reports to management.

Support the development and maintenance of Security Operations Centre (SOC) procedures, monitoring use cases, incident response processes and security documentation to enhance detection and response capabilities.
requirements: A bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science or a related field.
At least one year of experience as a Security Administrator, Network Administrator or in a related technical role, or equivalent knowledge.

Professional certification inCEH or CySA+ is mandatory. Additional certifications such as CISSP, CISA, CCNA or other recognised cybersecurity certifications are desirable and will be considered an added advantage.
Technical knowledge of SIEM & SOAR solutions, network, database and operating system security.
A good understanding of security methodologies, processes and technologies, including firewalls and intrusion detection systems.
jobs.howToApply: If you have the vigilance, technical expertise and drive to detect emerging threats and defend critical systems, we invite you to apply.

jobs.description: Home»Jobs»Experience Level»Management Jobs»IT Project Manager- Finance Systems Transformation NGO Job GAIN
responsibilities: GAIN is seeking to recruit an IT Project Manager-Finance Systems Transformation (Business Central) to manage the implementation of its cloud-based finance management information system, improving financial processes and bringing programme, grant and entity information together across GAIN.

Strong written and spoken English, clear reporting and the ability to collaborate across time zones are essential, alongside experience helping users adopt new systems through training, change support and operational handover.
